audit.reasoning: (1) Quote: 'Stress is always penultimate.' confirmed verbatim in the cited archive.org djvu text (Clifton 1995, printed p. 34); no file was held before, it is now saved in our files. (2) Deciding source is a 1995 SIL grammar sketch by the only linguist who has described Kaki Ae; Glottolog lists no other descriptive work, and the same author's 1997 Pacific Linguistics D-89 chapter (p. 18) and 1997 SIL-PNG OPD (p. 2) — both downloaded now, open access — carry the identical sentence, with a CV/CVV-only syllable canon and no weight, lexical or morphological conditions anywhere. So the penultimate fixed coding rests on the best available description and nothing contradicts it; it is 'adequate' rather than 'well-sourced' only because the evidence is a single unexemplified sentence from about two weeks of fieldwork, with no stress-marked forms or measurements. (3) Action: fill the empty quote/
